thread:
maria: CI on main is red after the dependency-constraints merge. failing tests in http client suite.

maria: stacktrace snippet:
```
E   AttributeError: 'str' object has no attribute 'encode'
.tox/py39/lib/python3.9/site-packages/charset_normalizer/api.py:47: AttributeError
```

dep-bot: auto-merged constraints bump (#712) — charset-normalizer 3.2.0 -> 4.0.0

sam: @maria can you paste the failing test name and a quick repro command?

maria: test file: tests/http/test_client.py::test_response_encoding
repro locally:
```
git checkout main
poetry install --no-root
pytest tests/http/test_client.py::test_response_encoding -q
```

kevin: re-ran locally with constraints from CI, same failure. :eyes: Looks like API changed in charset-normalizer 4.x

jen: do we have a quick rollback plan? if it's a transitive bump we can pin in constraints.txt and cut a small revert PR.

maria: yep. If someone can bisect which commit in the constraints bump introduced the 4.x pin that'd help. I don't want a full revert if only one package needs pinning.

sam: I'll try a CI rerun with the old constraints file first.

ci-bot: rerun requested by sam — build 8440 will run shortly

sam: rerun came back red, not flaky.

kevin: I'll run a lockfile bisect. plan:
```
git checkout main~1
# iterate through combined lock changes from the constraints PR
# quick approach: cherry-pick each constraints commit and run pytest for the failing test
```

kevin: found the exact change — the constraints PR updated requests-compat matrix which pulled in charset-normalizer 4.0 via httpx -> httpcore.

kevin: temporary mitigation: opened PR #719 to pin charset-normalizer==3.2.0 in constraints.txt and added a short note in the PR body describing the failing test.

maria: thanks @kevin. Can you add a short unit test in our ci/verify-locks that detects this encoding regression? even a smoke test on that one http path would catch it earlier.

kevin: added a quick check in #719 — runs the failing test subset in a fast job. also added you as reviewer @maria.

jen: once merged let's also update dependabot rules to prevent automatic transitive bumps without an approver — that's what caused this auto-merge.

sam: agree. tagging eng-infra and devex for followup: @eng-infra @devex :thumbsup:

maria: merging #719 now. after merge, I'll kick off a full green build and then revert the transient constraint rule if we want a cleaner followup.

kevin: green on the branch with pinned charset-normalizer. will watch main CI.

maria: excellent. follow-ups: (1) add a short guide in #eng-infra on how to triage transitive constraint bumps (bisect tips), (2) tighten auto-merge rules for constraints PRs.

sam: I'll draft the doc and ping you both for review later today.

maria: thanks team. closing this thread once main is green. :white_check_mark:
